_comment: Single source of truth for the gnsdk C ABI tables. C (gnsdk.h), Python and Rust consumers must agree with this file; the ctest abi_status_table checks the C side.

messages.GNSDK_OK_WARNINGS: ok; the engine reported warnings (see diagnostics or the warnings buffer)
messages.GNSDK_PARTIAL_UNSUPPORTED: partial result; some input was unimplemented, bad data, or the engine stopped early
messages.GNSDK_RESOURCE_LIMITED: allocation failed; the session is poisoned and the process should exit
messages.GNSDK_BUSY: another session is live in this process or a request is in flight
messages.GNSDK_STALE: process-global state no longer matches (different sleigh home) or the session is poisoned
messages.GNSDK_PROVIDER_FAILURE: the input (image, snapshot, language spec, options) could not be used
messages.GNSDK_ENGINE_FAILURE: the decompiler engine raised an internal error
messages.GNSDK_INVALID_ARGUMENT: null pointer, bad struct_size, bad range, or wrong session state
messages.GNSDK_NOT_INITIALIZED: gnsdk_init has not been called (or gnsdk_shutdown was)
